purpose: Landing-only marketing interpretations of real Spekvia screens. Original mobile captures remain unchanged.

prompts.words:
Use case: style-transfer / ui-mockup. Asset type: ONE production-quality flat mobile app marketing screen for the Spekvia landing page. FULL-BLEED PORTRAIT aspect ratio EXACTLY 720:1540 (ideally 1024x2192). No phone frame, no hand, no external background.
Inputs: image 1 is the existing real screen to restyle; image 2 is the authentic Spekvia logo; image 3 is the real Mivo character identity.
A coherent flat sticker design system, matching the same family as the Today screen: warm cream #FFF7E6 main canvas, dark ink #1B1647 typography and crisp 2–3px outlines, violet #5546F5 primary buttons, mint #74DDB0, sun #FFCB3D, sky #93D5FF and pink #FFB5D2 accent cards. Friendly chunky rounded display headings like Lilita One and clear Figtree-like body. Large rounded rectangles, 28px safe padding in 720px units, small hard offset ink shadows. Polished, spacious and readable inside a 300px-wide phone on a website. Flat UI, a few beautiful small illustrated stickers only where meaningful. Do not render frosted glass, gradients, generic glossy 3D UI, fine print, excessive decoration, smartphone shell, statusbar, notch, battery, clocks, watermarks or anything outside the canvas.
REMOVE ALL Expo Go floating developer cogs/gears/settings buttons and every loading spinner. No developer icons anywhere. Preserve real product features; simplify their presentation for a marketing screen. Correct Turkish typography and accents, verbatim specified text. Output only ONE upright screen.
Vocabulary overview screen. Composition from top to bottom: small authentic Spekvia wordmark; bold headline 'Kelimeler'; compact header right has a sun pill '1 gün' and an outlined add icon. Rounded white row 'Sandığım' with smaller '6 kelime · Senin kelimelerin' and a simple search icon. Main large sun-yellow card with heading 'Bugünün destesi', huge '6 kelime', smaller 'Yaklaşık 2 dakika'; at right, a stylish small stack of illustrated flashcards with a book and travel bag image, clean ink outlines and soft color fills. Primary violet pill 'Başla' with arrow. Beneath, a compact 2x2 grid of cream/mint/sky/lilac cards with simple outlined illustrated icons and exact labels 'Kütüphane' / '900 temel kelime', 'Gruplarım' / 'Etiketler ve seviyeler', 'Odalar' / 'Görerek öğren', 'Telaffuz' / 'Dinle ve söyle'. Bottom compact progress card 'İlerlemen' with four counters: '5 Yeni', '1 Öğreniliyor', '0 Oturuyor', '0 Kalıcı'. A tidy cream bottom navigation with simple line icons and labels 'Bugün', 'Konuş', 'Kelimeler', 'Profil'; Kelimeler active violet. Preserve hierarchy, don't overcrowd. No Mivo character needed on this screen.

prompts.today:
Use case: style-transfer / ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE polished, front-facing, full-bleed portrait mobile screen for the Spekvia landing page. Canvas aspect ratio EXACTLY 720:1540, ideally 1024x2192 or 720x1540. No device frame, no background outside the screen.
Input 1 is the existing Today screen: preserve its real feature content and visual story. Input 2 is the authentic Bristol story artwork to reuse in the central card. Input 3 is the actual Spekvia wordmark. Input 4 is the brand's Mivo mascot for identity reference.
Primary request: professionally redesign this marketing screen to match a playful flat sticker-style website. REMOVE every Expo Go developer gear/cog, overlay and loading artifact. The output is a beautifully composed simplified marketing interpretation of the real screen.
Design system: warm cream #FFF7E6 background; dark ink #1B1647 text and 2–3px clean outlines; violet #5546F5 primary accents; sun yellow #FFCB3D, mint #74DDB0, sky #93D5FF and pink #FFB5D2 only as coherent accents. Crisp rounded cards, slightly offset hard ink shadows, flat clean colors, very restrained star stickers. Bold friendly rounded display headings like Lilita One, highly legible Figtree-like body type. No gradients, frosted glass, generic 3D interface icons, or soft glowing interface.
Composition: full screen upright, consistent 28px safe padding in 720px reference units. A compact top header with small real Spekvia logo, a sun-colored streak pill '1 gün' and a tiny circular user avatar. Below, small mint pill 'A1 · Bölüm 2/36', big dark title 'Bugün ne öğrenelim?'. A large rounded illustrated story card using the supplied authentic Bristol illustration with both characters fully recognizable. Card text exactly: 'Bristol’a hoş geldin' and smaller 'I am / You are · 4 dk'. Prominent violet pill 'Devam et' with white text and a simple play arrow. Under the story card, simple section 'Ünite 1 · Ben ve sen' and a 6-node progress line with the first node highlighted. Small mint completion cue 'Her gün küçük bir adım.' Above the bottom edge, tidy cream navigation bar with simple line icons and exact labels 'Bugün', 'Konuş', 'Kelimeler', 'Profil'; Bugün active in violet.
Constraints: strong visual hierarchy, few readable words, no lorem ipsum, no invented feature claims, no developer gear or settings button anywhere, no spinner, no notch/status bar/time/battery, no hand, no device shell, no duplicated screens, no outside headline, no watermark. Keep all content inside the canvas. All Turkish text must be spelled correctly. Output only the designed screen.
